is a 2024 Japanese historical war film directed by Shinsuke Sato. An adaptation of the manga of the same name by Yasuhisa Hara, the film is the sequel to Kingdom 3: The Flame of Destiny (2023).
Synopsis
As the fierce battle between Qin and Zhao continued, the direct confrontation between Wang Qi and Pang Nuan finally began.
